description: Frozen destructive/data-moving partition contract: DROP PARTITION / TRUNCATE PARTITION / EXCHANGE PARTITION are audited actions with frozen rule IDs (ddl.alter.drop_partition.forbid blocker, ddl.alter.truncate_partition.forbid blocker, ddl.alter.exchange_partition.warn warning), partition-name attribution, the exchanged-table identity entering TableTargets so protected-object rules see both sides, complete coverage on all four anchors, and ordered-state that keeps member facts while dropping data-derived statistics (multi-spec partition ALTER is a proven native refusal) — independent T13 acceptance contract

ddl_steps.name: create-partitioned-fixture
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t13g (id INT, c INT) PARTITION BY RANGE (id) (PARTITION p0 VALUES LESS THAN (100), PARTITION p1 VALUES LESS THAN (200))

verify.assert: range fixture lands with two named partitions on every anchor
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='golden' AND TABLE_NAME='t13g' AND PARTITION_NAME IS NOT NULL

verify.assert: the p1-range row lands
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golden.t13g WHERE id >= 100

ddl_steps.name: drop-partition-p0
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t13g DROP PARTITION p0

verify.assert: p0 definition is gone after DROP PARTITION
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='golden' AND TABLE_NAME='t13g' AND PARTITION_NAME='p0'

verify.assert: p1's row survives the drop
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golden.t13g WHERE id >= 100

ddl_steps.name: truncate-partition-p1
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t13g TRUNCATE PARTITION p1

verify.assert: p1 definition survives TRUNCATE while its rows are gone
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='golden' AND TABLE_NAME='t13g' AND PARTITION_NAME='p1'

verify.assert: no rows remain in the table after both partitions emptied
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golden.t13g

ddl_steps.name: create-exchange-counterpart
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t13x (id INT, c INT)

verify.assert: exchange counterpart is a plain non-partitioned table
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='golden' AND TABLE_NAME='t13x' AND PARTITION_NAME IS NOT NULL

verify.assert: counterpart row lands inside p1 range (100 <= 160 < 200)
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golden.t13x

ddl_steps.name: exchange-partition-p1
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t13g EXCHANGE PARTITION p1 WITH TABLE t13x WITHOUT VALIDATION

verify.assert: the counterpart row moved into the partitioned table
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golden.t13g

verify.assert: the counterpart is empty after the swap
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golden.t13x

verify.assert: fixtures removed
verify.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='golden' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('t13g','t13x')
